title: First bands: Superior Band, Celestine, and the Piron partnership
summary: He names the Superior Band's members and uniforms, the stock arrangements they read, and says he left around 1915 to team up with Piron for some 15 years.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, sure. Yeah. How about your two brothers? Did they start playing after you or before you? After me, yeah. After you. Uh-huh. What was the first band you started playing with?

Well, the first band I started was, let's see, the Superior, I think, was the first band. And then I played with Papa Celestine, you know, different fellows. Remember who was in the Superior? Well, that's Bunk, you know, his fellow here, Bunk Johnson and Billy Marrera, and Louis Nelson, myself, Buddy Johnson.
And Walter Brunney was playing drums, you know. Oh, yeah. Yeah. That's the same as that photo, that photograph with them on? Yes, that's the one. Yeah.
What uniforms did they have? You know, what color were their uniforms? Well, they were blue. Uh-huh. That's the blue. Dark blue, like that?
Uh-huh. What kind of stuff did you play with that band?

Well, we played mostly stocks, you know, in this old job, the music, we played a lot of that too, you see. But those days we used to get those stock numbers, you know. Yeah. All right, stock arrangements, you see.
Uh-huh. Did you all read music in that band?
And would you play the lead on the violin?
Uh-huh. How long were you in that band?

Oh, I stayed with them a good while. Up until about, you see, 1915 I think, when Pierre and I got together. And we started playing together, you know, and then we played, clean up until the 30s we played together. It was about, oh, about 15 years we were together with that one. Mm-hmm .
